assessments.summary: Potato material supplied as tuber tissue in the linked recipes. The material input is distinct from liquid potato infusion or extract after boiling and filtration. Case 16 occurrences carrying peeled-and-cut notes are additionally bound to the more specific peeled/cut material proposal. Starting potato masses are process input amounts, not measured retained solids in a filtrate. FOODON 03315354 names a potato tuber; FOODON 00002796 covers whole/piece derivatives, but no exact claim erases a recipe-specific preparation. JCM 30/54/55/116 and the explicitly qualified frozen rows supply peeled, cut potato as a preparation input. Cut does not specify a dice size, so the existing Diced Potato owner is not an exact substitute. JCM 30 boils 200 g in 1 L for 20 min then sieves; JCM 54/55 combine potato and carrot and filter through cheesecloth. Those outputs remain distinct; the record describes the peeled/cut tissue before extraction.

assessments.summary: JCM905/906 and the source M460-derived record explicitly identify BD-Difco Bacto agar as the solidifier grade. The owner represents the unwashed Bacto grade; washed P1 occurrence of case84 and unspecified agar-agar case57 remain excluded. Raw source labels remain in campaign case evidence; no unqualified global alias is added. This isolated proposal does not clear inherited owner publication holds. Successor case84 is occurrence-resolved: CCAP EA, DSMZ958 and PYE Top agar use unwashed Bacto grade and may bind this owner. MediaDiveP1 HaHa explicitly washes the agar three times and binds a separate processed preparation. Unqualified case57 Difco agar-agar and conflicting case121 remain excluded. No raw Bacto agar alias is installed globally. This original case retains its supplier-grade binding while the same owner now accepts the explicitly bounded additional occurrence(s). No prior approval is inherited.

assessments.summary: M2313 names xylan from oat spelts as an alternative carbon-substrate input. This is a botanical xylan preparation distinct from larchwood and beechwood products. CHEBI 37166 is the generic xylose-residue polymer class; no purity or molecular equivalence of the complete botanical preparation is proven. Use a registry identity without invented CAS, purity or has-part constituents.

Manufacturer214050 confirms the Bacto product identity as distinct from Noble214220. The owner represents the unwashed Bacto grade; washed P1 occurrence of case84 and unspecified agar-agar case57 remain excluded. Successor case84 is occurrence-resolved: CCAP EA, DSMZ958 and PYE Top agar use unwashed Bacto grade and may bind this owner. No raw Bacto agar alias is installed globally. MediaDive publicP1 HaHa agar explicitly uses washed Bacto agar. Its linked washed-agar preparation starts with12.6g Bacto agar, adds600ml ultrapure water, settles/removes overlay, and repeats washing twice; final wet preparation volume is less than300ml. This processing-qualified material is distinct from untouched commercial Bacto agar. These are preparation inputs, not a final mass fraction or a has-part relation among grades; no dry-grade component edge or washing-water retention is invented. Raw source labels and optional/use instructions are retained in source-case evidence, not installed as global resolving aliases. Existing source/owner/export holds remain; no maintained or release approval.
